definitions.explanation: A sudden arrival of cold air that brings a sharp drop in temperature. A meteorological term commonly used in weather forecasts and news reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{寒波|かんぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A strong cold wave is coming.

examples.japanese: {寒波|かんぱ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水道管|すいどうかん}→水道管：08094_suidoukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍結|とうけつ}→凍結：09613_touketsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The water pipes froze due to the cold wave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大|おお}{寒波|かんぱ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧になった。
examples.english: This year brought a once-in-several-years major cold wave, with record-breaking heavy snowfall across the country.

notes:
USAGE:
{寒波|かんぱ} is a standard meteorological term used frequently in weather forecasts and news during winter. It describes a large-scale inflow of cold air, typically from Siberia in the case of Japan.
The opposite phenomenon is ⟦{熱波|ねっぱ}→熱波：19794_neppa⟧ (heat wave).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{寒波|かんぱ} — major cold wave
- {寒波|かんぱ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧／⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧ — a cold wave arrives/hits
- {寒波|かんぱ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ — due to the cold wave
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{寒波|かんぱ} — record-breaking cold wave
